abstract: Maintains participant comfort, lounge amenity records, and visitor satisfaction indices
system_message:
You are Delegate hospitality coordinator (DHC). You serve as the Delegate hospitality coordinator (DHC), responsible for tracking participant comfort, hospitality lounge amenity standards, and attendee satisfaction records across evaluated candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Airport express transit（SHUT）
information_points.content:
DHC-SHUT-UPE：The transport concession for Forthview Exhibition Arena establishes a dedicated airport shuttle coach fleet of 8 coaches operating the express link from Edinburgh Airport.
DHC-SHUT-G76：Under the direct express link from Edinburgh Airport, Waverley Royal Congress Hall is allocated a dedicated airport shuttle coach fleet of 12 coaches.
DHC-SHUT-Y1B：For Holyrood Park International Pavilion, the direct express route connecting with Edinburgh Airport is serviced by a dedicated airport shuttle coach fleet of 4 coaches.

information_points.title: Maintains participant comfort, lounge amenity records, and visitor satisfaction indices（HOSP）
information_points.content:
DHC-HOSP-LQ7：At Waverley Royal Congress Hall, the delegate lounge comfort index across executive hospitality pavilions and quiet working lounges is evaluated at 82 points on the standardized 100-point hospitality index.
DHC-HOSP-VBD：Holyrood Park International Pavilion achieved a delegate lounge comfort index of 91 points based on satisfaction assessments covering executive hospitality pavilions and quiet working lounges.
DHC-HOSP-F1Q：For Forthview Exhibition Arena, the delegate lounge comfort index measured across executive hospitality pavilions and quiet working lounges stands at 74 points on the standardized 100-point hospitality index.
